plan: Implement the planning canvas panel: PlanningCanvasPanel mixes OutlineNode/StoryEntity/PlotThread nodes on one canvas with parent-child edges (OutlineNode.parentId) and cross-reference edges (characterIds/plotThreadIds). PlanningNodeContent renders 3 node types via discriminated union. Wire into PlanningWorkspace as 'board' mode. Then satisfy meta signals (intent-preserved, no-open-required-work) for final completion.
actions: Created PlanningNodeContent.tsx: renders 3 node types via PlanningNodeData discriminated union (outline/entity/thread). Outline nodes show kind-colored icon (ApartmentOutlined/UnorderedListOutlined/ThunderboltOutlined), title, kind Tag (幕/序列/事件 with per-kind color), summary, status, reference counts (characterIds/plotThreadIds). Entity nodes show avatar initial, name, role, summary. Thread nodes show BookOutlined icon, title, status Tag (计划中/进行中/暂停/已解决/已废弃), summary. All include data-planning-node and data-planning-type attributes.

Created PlanningCanvasPanel.tsx: full panel loading outlineNodes, entities (characters), and threads via useLiveQuery. Items combine all three types into CanvasPanelItem<PlanningNodeData>[] with kind='outline'|'entity'|'thread'. Edges derived from domain data: parent-child edges from OutlineNode.parentId, reference edges from characterIds (label '角色', kind 'reference') and plotThreadIds (label '剧情线', kind 'reference'). Edge IDs use prefixed format (parent:/ref-char:/ref-thread:) for type identification. Custom planningLayout: 3-column layout (outline at x=40, entity at x=560, thread at x=1080), vertical by type-index. Outline node editor Drawer (title, status, summary, causality, outcome). AddOutlineNodeModal with kind picker. Delete: outline nodes via deleteOutlineBranch, entities/threads redirect to their panels. Context menu, keyboard shortcuts, minimap, zoom controls.

Created PlanningCanvasPanel.test.tsx: 11 SSR tests. 8 for PlanningNodeContent (outline name/kind/summary, outline status/ref counts, outline empty fallback, entity name/role/summary, entity empty fallback, thread title/status/summary, thread empty fallback, data attributes for all 3 types). 3 for PlanningCanvasPanel (header '策划工作台'/'PLANNING CANVAS'/'添加大纲节点', empty state '画布为空'/'添加第一个大纲节点', undo/redo buttons).

Wired PlanningCanvasPanel into PlanningWorkspace.tsx: added lazy import, added 'board' to PlanningMode type, added Segmented option { value: 'board', label: '策划画布' }, added Suspense+canvas case in content useMemo. Added Spin to antd imports.
Ran vitest: 17 test files, 139 tests passed (11 new planning + 128 existing). Ran tsc --noEmit: exit 0, no errors.

Satisfied meta signals: intent-preserved (goal brief preserves user intent — canvas core + node interactions ported, 4 panels integrated, IndexedDB persistence, no AI/prompt/Agent chat) and no-open-required-work (all 10 success signals satisfied, all 4 panels implemented and tested).

selfReflection: Loop 7 completed the final canvas panel and the overall goal. The planning canvas is the most complex panel because it mixes three domain types (OutlineNode, StoryEntity, PlotThread) on a single canvas. The discriminated union PlanningNodeData pattern cleanly handles the three node types in both the content component and the panel. Edges are entirely derived from existing domain data (parentId, characterIds, plotThreadIds) — no separate edge storage needed, which keeps the data model clean. The 3-column layout (outline/entity/thread) provides clear visual separation by type, and the user can drag nodes to rearrange. Parent-child and reference edges are rendered with different labels for visual distinction. All four panels now share the same useCanvasPanel hook and CanvasNodeShell component, demonstrating the reusability of the canvas core. The custom layoutStrategy function pattern (introduced in loop 5 for timeline, reused in loop 6 for worldview, and here for planning) has proven to be a flexible extension point for domain-specific positioning. The goal is complete: canvas core ported, persistence implemented, 4 panels integrated, 139 tests pass, tsc clean.
